info.title: Backlog Syntax API
info.description: Contract-first REST API for a secure, multi-tenant, agent-native backlog.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-backlog_session
sessionCookie.description: Better Auth browser session cookie. The configured name may differ locally.

nextCursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

get.description: Returns the authenticated principal and trusted context for one accessible workspace.
Returns a portable export of the authenticated account and its owned data.

post.description: Deletes the authenticated account after the submitted email confirms the request.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of workspaces accessible to the principal.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Creates a workspace owned by the authenticated principal.

get.description: Returns the audit event history for one task in an accessible workspace.

post.description: Appends an idempotent audit event when the submitted task version is current.

get.description: Returns a portable export of one accessible workspace and its domain data.

patch.description: Updates mutable settings for one accessible workspace.

delete.description: Permanently deletes one accessible workspace and its domain data.

get.description: Returns a filtered, cursor-paginated list of projects in one workspace.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Creates an idempotent project in one accessible workspace.

get.description: Returns one project when it belongs to the requested accessible workspace.

patch.description: Updates one project through an idempotent workspace-scoped request.

delete.description: Deletes one project through an idempotent workspace-scoped request.

get.description: Returns a filtered, cursor-paginated list of tasks in one workspace.

schema.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response.
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Creates an idempotent task in one accessible workspace.

get.description: Returns one task and its current version from an accessible workspace.

patch.description: Updates one task idempotently when the If-Match version matches current state.

delete.description: Deletes one task idempotently when the If-Match version matches current state.

post.description: Creates a time-limited task claim when the submitted version is current.
Extends an active task claim when the submitted version is current.
Releases an active task claim when the submitted version is current.
Transfers an active task claim to another eligible principal.

get.description: Returns service accounts bound to one accessible workspace.

post.description: Creates a scoped technical principal bound to one accessible workspace.

delete.description: Revokes one workspace service account and all tokens issued to it.

get.description: Returns token metadata for service accounts in one accessible workspace.

post.description: Issues a scoped API token whose secret is returned only in this response.

201.description: API token created; secret is returned once

delete.description: Revokes one API token in an accessible workspace.
